entry.codeblock: # Configuring Alarm Notifications To configure alarm notifications: 1. Open the Notification Settings page. 2. Configure the notification settings. 3. Save the configuration. Related Tasks - [Creating an Alarm Type](creating-an-alarm-type.md) - [Managing Alarm Recipients](managing-alarm-recipients.md) - [Configuring Email Notifications](configuring-email-notifications.md)

section.p: Result:The converter recognizes that the list contains links to related topics rather than procedural content. Instead of converting the list into a DITA unordered list, it generates a DITA <related-links> section containing individual <link> elements. This preserves the navigational relationship between the current task and the related procedures.
